list_users.title: List or search users
list_users.description: Page through the tenant's users, or search them with a Lucene query in q such as 'email:"ada@example.com"' or 'identities.connection:"google-oauth2"'. Auth0 caps this endpoint at 1000 results; export a full directory with start_users_export instead.

q.description: Lucene query over the user records, e.g. 'email:"ada@example.com"'.

search_engine.description: Search engine version. Use v3 unless you need legacy behaviour.

connection.description: Restrict to one connection name. Only honoured with search_engine v1.

sort.description: Sort as field:order, where order is 1 ascending or -1 descending.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude from each user.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

page.description: Zero-based page index of the result set.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total, start and limit counts.

output.description: A page of user records, or an object with users plus totals.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: Read one user by user_id, including identities, app_metadata and user_metadata. Narrow the payload with fields when you only need a few attributes.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

output.description: The user record, with identities, metadata and login stats.

get_users_by_email.title: Find users by email address
get_users_by_email.description: Look up every user whose email matches exactly, across connections. The match is case-sensitive, and this endpoint only covers database and passwordless connections.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

output.description: An array of matching users; empty when nothing matches.

create_user.title: Create a user
create_user.description: Create a user in a database or passwordless connection. connection is required, and the connection decides which identifier applies -- email and password for a database connection, phone_number for SMS.

connection.description: Name of the connection to create the user in.

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number, for SMS connections.

username.description: Username, where the connection requires one.

nickname.description: Short display name for the user.

picture.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

user_id.description: Identifier to use inside the connection, instead of a generated one.

email_verified.description: True to mark the email as already verified.

phone_verified.description: True to mark the phone number as already verified.

verify_email.description: True to send the verification email after creating the user.

blocked.description: True to create the user already blocked from logging in.

user_metadata.description: Data the user can edit, such as preferences.

app_metadata.description: Data only the application may edit, such as roles or plan.

output.description: The created user, including its generated user_id.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Patch a user's profile, metadata or blocked state. Metadata objects are merged key by key -- send a key as null to remove it. Changing email or phone_number needs the connection to allow it.

email.description: New email address for the user.

phone_number.description: New E.164 phone number for the user.

name.description: New full name for the user.

connection.description: Connection the user belongs to. Required with email, password or username.

client_id.description: Client to attribute the change to, for verification emails.

email_verified.description: Whether the email counts as verified.

phone_verified.description: Whether the phone number counts as verified.

verify_email.description: True to send a verification email after changing the address.

verify_phone_number.description: True to send a verification SMS after changing the number.

blocked.description: True to block the user from logging in, false to unblock.

user_metadata.description: User-editable metadata to merge into the record.

app_metadata.description: Application-only metadata to merge into the record.

delete_user.title: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Permanently delete a user and every identity linked to it. The user's sessions and refresh tokens go with it; log entries stay.

list_user_roles.title: List a user's roles
list_user_roles.description: Page through the roles assigned directly to one user. Roles inherited through an organization membership are not listed here.

id.description: User id whose roles to list.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of roles, each with id, name and description.

assign_user_roles.title: Assign roles to a user
assign_user_roles.description: Add one or more existing roles to a user by role id. Roles the user already holds are ignored, so the call is safe to repeat.

id.description: User id to assign roles to.

remove_user_roles.title: Remove roles from a user
remove_user_roles.description: Take one or more roles away from a user by role id. The roles themselves are untouched; only this user's assignment is removed.

id.description: User id to remove roles from.

list_user_permissions.title: List a user's permissions
list_user_permissions.description: Page through the permissions granted directly to a user, each with the resource server it belongs to. Permissions that come from a role are not included.

id.description: User id whose permissions to list.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of permissions, with resource_server_identifier on each.

assign_user_permissions.title: Grant permissions to a user
assign_user_permissions.description: Grant permissions directly to a user. Each entry names the resource server identifier and the permission_name defined on it.

id.description: User id to grant permissions to.

remove_user_permissions.title: Revoke permissions from a user
remove_user_permissions.description: Remove permissions previously granted directly to a user. Each entry names the resource server identifier and the permission_name.

id.description: User id to revoke permissions from.

list_user_effective_roles.title: List a user's effective roles
list_user_effective_roles.description: List every role that actually applies to the user, direct assignments and roles inherited through group membership together.

id.description: User id whose effective roles to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

output.description: A page of effective roles with the next cursor.

list_user_effective_permissions.title: List a user's effective permissions
list_user_effective_permissions.description: List every permission the user ends up with, whether granted directly or picked up through a role or group.

id.description: User id whose effective permissions to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

output.description: A page of effective permissions with the next cursor.

list_user_groups.title: List a user's groups
list_user_groups.description: List the groups the user belongs to. Groups come from an enterprise connection's directory sync rather than being managed in Auth0.

id.description: User id whose groups to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

output.description: A page of groups with the next cursor.

list_user_logs.title: List a user's log events
list_user_logs.description: Read the tenant log entries for one user, newest first by default. Auth0 keeps log data for a limited retention window that depends on the plan.

id.description: User id whose log events to read.

sort.description: Sort as field:1 ascending or field:-1 descending, e.g. date:-1.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of log events, each with type, date, ip and client.

list_user_organizations.title: List a user's organizations
list_user_organizations.description: List the organizations this user is a member of, with their display names and branding. Use it to see which tenants a user can sign in to.

id.description: User id whose organizations to list.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, for checkpoint paging.

take.description: Results per page when paging by cursor.

output.description: A page of organizations the user belongs to.

link_user_identity.title: Link a second account to a user
link_user_identity.description: Link another account into this user as a secondary identity. Either pass link_with with the secondary account's own access token, or name the provider and user_id of the account to absorb.

id.description: Primary user id that will own the linked identity.

link_with.description: Access token of the secondary account to link.

provider.description: Identity provider of the secondary account, e.g. google-oauth2.

user_id.description: Provider-side user id of the secondary account.

connection_id.description: Connection id of the secondary account, when the provider is ambiguous.

output.description: The primary user's identities after linking.

unlink_user_identity.title: Unlink an identity from a user
unlink_user_identity.description: Detach a secondary identity from a user; the detached identity becomes a user of its own again. Unlinking the primary identity is not allowed.

id.description: Primary user id to unlink from.

provider.description: Identity provider of the secondary identity.

user_id.description: Provider-side user id of the secondary identity.

output.description: The identities remaining on the primary user.

list_user_sessions.title: List a user's sessions
list_user_sessions.description: List the user's active sessions, with the device, client and last interaction on each. Pages by cursor rather than page number.

user_id.description: User id whose sessions to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of sessions with device and client details.

delete_user_sessions.title: Delete all of a user's sessions
delete_user_sessions.description: Delete every session belonging to the user, signing them out everywhere. Refresh tokens survive unless you revoke those too.

user_id.description: User id whose sessions to delete.

list_user_refresh_tokens.title: List a user's refresh tokens
list_user_refresh_tokens.description: List the refresh tokens issued to one user, with the client and session behind each. Pages by cursor rather than page number.

user_id.description: User id whose refresh tokens to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of refresh tokens with client and session ids.

delete_user_refresh_tokens.title: Delete all of a user's refresh tokens
delete_user_refresh_tokens.description: Revoke every refresh token issued to the user, so offline access has to be granted again at the next login.

user_id.description: User id whose refresh tokens to revoke.

revoke_user_access.title: Revoke a user's access
revoke_user_access.description: Sign a user out and revoke their tokens in one call. Pass session_id to target a single session, or preserve_refresh_tokens to keep offline access alive.

id.description: User id whose access to revoke.

session_id.description: Revoke only this session instead of all of them.

preserve_refresh_tokens.description: True to leave the user's refresh tokens in place.

list_user_authentication_methods.title: List a user's authentication methods
list_user_authentication_methods.description: List the enrolled authentication methods on a user -- passkeys, authenticator apps, phone numbers, email and recovery codes.

id.description: User id whose authentication methods to list.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of authentication methods with type and confirmation state.

delete_user_authentication_method.title: Delete one authentication method
delete_user_authentication_method.description: Remove a single enrolled authentication method from a user, for instance a lost phone or a retired authenticator app.

id.description: User id the method belongs to.

authentication_method_id.description: Id of the authentication method to delete.

delete_user_authentication_methods.title: Delete all of a user's authentication methods
delete_user_authentication_methods.description: Remove every enrolled authentication method from the user, so they have to enrol again at the next login that requires one.

id.description: User id whose authentication methods to delete.

list_user_mfa_enrollments.title: List a user's MFA enrollments
list_user_mfa_enrollments.description: List the user's Guardian multifactor enrollments, with the type, status and enrolment date of each.

id.description: User id whose MFA enrollments to list.

delete_user_mfa_provider.title: Remove a user's MFA enrollment for a provider
delete_user_mfa_provider.description: Delete the user's multifactor enrolment for one provider, forcing a fresh enrolment the next time MFA is required.

id.description: User id whose enrolment to delete.

delete_user_authenticators.title: Delete a user's MFA authenticators
delete_user_authenticators.description: Remove every multifactor authenticator from the user at once, which is the usual recovery path when someone loses all their factors.

id.description: User id whose authenticators to delete.

invalidate_remembered_browsers.title: Invalidate a user's remembered browsers
invalidate_remembered_browsers.description: Clear the "remember this browser" grants for a user's multifactor enrollments, so MFA is prompted again on every device.

id.description: User id whose remembered browsers to invalidate.

regenerate_recovery_code.title: Regenerate a user's recovery code
regenerate_recovery_code.description: Invalidate the user's multifactor recovery code and return a fresh one. The new code is shown once in the response and cannot be read again.

id.description: User id whose recovery code to regenerate.

get_user_blocks.title: Get the blocks on a user identifier
get_user_blocks.description: Read the brute-force blocks recorded against a username, email or phone number, with the IP address each block came from.

identifier.description: Username, email address or phone number to check.

consider_brute_force_enablement.description: True to report blocks only when brute-force protection is on.

output.description: The blocked_for entries for the identifier.

delete_user_blocks.title: Unblock a user identifier
delete_user_blocks.description: Clear the brute-force blocks recorded against a username, email or phone number so that logins are accepted again.

identifier.description: Username, email address or phone number to unblock.

delete_user_blocks_by_id.title: Unblock a user by id
delete_user_blocks_by_id.description: Clear every brute-force block on one user id. This does not change the blocked flag set by an administrator on the user record.

list_clients.title: List applications
list_clients.description: Page through the tenant's applications (clients). Filter by app_type, first-party status or a Lucene query in q, and use fields to keep the payload small -- client secrets are only returned when asked for.

q.description: Lucene query over the client records.

is_global.description: Filter on the global client flag.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, for checkpoint paging.

take.description: Results per page when paging by cursor.

output.description: A page of applications with their ids, types and callbacks.

get_client.title: Get an application
get_client.description: Read one application by client id, including its callbacks, grant types and connection settings.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

search_clients.title: Search applications
search_clients.description: Search applications with a SCIM or Lucene filter expression and checkpoint paging, which is the endpoint built for large tenants.

q.description: Filter expression, in the syntax parser names.

parser.description: Which filter syntax q is written in.

sort.description: Field name to sort ascending by; defaults to insertion order.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

take.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

output.description: A page of matching applications with the next cursor.

create_client.title: Create an application
create_client.description: Register a new application. app_type decides which settings apply -- a spa or native app gets no client secret worth keeping, while a regular_web or non_interactive app does.

callbacks.description: Allowed callback URLs for the login flow.

allowed_logout_urls.description: URLs the user may be redirected to after logout.

allowed_origins.description: Origins allowed to make cross-origin authentication calls.

web_origins.description: Origins allowed for silent authentication in a browser.

grant_types.description: OAuth grant types the application may use.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the application authenticates at the token endpoint.

is_first_party.description: True when the application belongs to the tenant owner.

oidc_conformant.description: True to enforce OIDC-conformant token behaviour.

sso.description: True to take part in single sign-on across applications.

jwt_configuration.description: Token lifetime and signing algorithm for issued JWTs.

client_metadata.description: Up to ten string key-value pairs stored with the application.

organization_usage.description: Whether logins may, must or must not carry an organization.

organization_require_behavior.description: How the login prompt asks for the organization when required.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token rotation and expiration policy.

output.description: The created application, including its client_id and secret.

update_client.title: Update an application
update_client.description: Patch an application's settings. Arrays such as callbacks replace the stored value wholesale, so send the full list you want to keep.

id.description: Client id of the application to update.

callbacks.description: Replacement list of allowed callback URLs.

allowed_logout_urls.description: Replacement list of allowed logout URLs.

grant_types.description: Replacement list of OAuth grant types.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the application authenticates at the token endpoint.

oidc_conformant.description: True to enforce OIDC-conformant token behaviour.

sso.description: True to take part in single sign-on.

jwt_configuration.description: New token lifetime and signing settings.

organization_usage.description: Whether logins may, must or must not carry an organization.

organization_require_behavior.description: How the login prompt asks for the organization.

delete_client.title: Delete an application
delete_client.description: Delete an application. Every grant, session and token issued to it stops working, so check list_client_grants first.

id.description: Client id of the application to delete.

rotate_client_secret.title: Rotate an application's secret
rotate_client_secret.description: Generate a new client secret for the application and invalidate the old one immediately. The new secret appears in the response only.

id.description: Client id whose secret to rotate.

output.description: The application with its new client_secret.

list_client_connections.title: List an application's connections
list_client_connections.description: List the connections enabled for one application, which is what decides the identity providers its login page offers.

id.description: Client id whose connections to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

output.description: A page of connections enabled for the application.

list_client_credentials.title: List an application's credentials
list_client_credentials.description: List the private-key-JWT and mTLS credentials registered on an application. Public key material is returned; private keys never are.

client_id.description: Client id whose credentials to list.

output.description: An array of credentials with id, name, algorithm and thumbprint.

get_client_credential.title: Get an application credential
get_client_credential.description: Read one credential on an application, with its algorithm, expiry and the fingerprint of the public key.

client_id.description: Client id the credential belongs to.

credential_id.description: Id of the credential to read.

create_client_credential.title: Add a credential to an application
create_client_credential.description: Register a public key or certificate on an application so it can authenticate with private-key JWT or mTLS instead of a shared secret.

client_id.description: Client id to add the credential to.

alg.description: Signing algorithm for a public key credential.

parse_expiry_from_cert.description: True to take the expiry from the certificate itself.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the credential stops working.

subject_dn.description: Certificate subject distinguished name, for the cert_subject_dn type.

kid.description: Key id the client will put in its JWT headers; generated when omitted.

output.description: The created credential, with its id.

update_client_credential.title: Update an application credential
update_client_credential.description: Change the expiry on a registered credential. The key material itself cannot be replaced -- add a new credential and remove the old one.

client_id.description: Client id the credential belongs to.

credential_id.description: Id of the credential to update.

expires_at.description: New ISO 8601 expiry, or null to remove the expiry.

delete_client_credential.title: Delete an application credential
delete_client_credential.description: Remove a credential from an application. Anything still authenticating with that key immediately stops being able to get tokens.

client_id.description: Client id the credential belongs to.

credential_id.description: Id of the credential to delete.

list_client_grants.title: List client grants
list_client_grants.description: List the machine-to-machine grants in the tenant -- which application may request tokens for which API, and with which scopes. Filter by client_id or audience to narrow it down.

client_id.description: Restrict to grants held by this application.

audience.description: Restrict to grants for this API identifier.

subject_type.description: Restrict to grants of this access kind.

allow_any_organization.description: True to list only grants usable with any organization.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, for checkpoint paging.

take.description: Results per page when paging by cursor.

output.description: A page of client grants with client_id, audience and scope.

get_client_grant.title: Get a client grant
get_client_grant.description: Read one machine-to-machine grant by id, with the scopes and organization rules attached to it.

create_client_grant.title: Create a client grant
create_client_grant.description: Authorize an application to request tokens for an API, with the scopes it may ask for. The audience must match an existing resource server.

audience.description: Identifier of the API the grant is for.

scope.description: Scopes the application may request, e.g. ["read:users"].

organization_usage.description: Whether the grant may, must or must not name an organization.

allow_any_organization.description: True to let the grant be used with any organization.

subject_type.description: Kind of access the grant allows.

output.description: The created client grant, with its id.

update_client_grant.title: Update a client grant
update_client_grant.description: Change the scopes or organization rules on an existing grant. The scope array replaces the stored one wholesale.

id.description: Id of the client grant to update.

scope.description: Replacement list of scopes the application may request.

organization_usage.description: Whether the grant may, must or must not name an organization.

allow_any_organization.description: True to let the grant be used with any organization.

delete_client_grant.title: Delete a client grant
delete_client_grant.description: Revoke an application's authorization to request tokens for an API. Any tokens already issued stay valid until they expire.

id.description: Id of the client grant to delete.

list_client_grant_organizations.title: List organizations on a client grant
list_client_grant_organizations.description: List the organizations a grant has been associated with, for grants that are scoped to specific organizations rather than any of them.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

output.description: A page of organizations linked to the grant.

list_connections.title: List connections
list_connections.description: Page through the tenant's connections -- the identity sources logins can come from. Filter by strategy to see just the database, social or enterprise ones.

name.description: Exact connection name to look up.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, for checkpoint paging.

take.description: Results per page when paging by cursor.

output.description: A page of connections with their strategies and options.

get_connection.title: Get a connection
get_connection.description: Read one connection by id, including the strategy-specific options block that holds its provider configuration.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

output.description: The connection record with its options.

create_connection.title: Create a connection
create_connection.description: Create a connection. strategy is fixed at creation time and decides which keys the options object accepts -- "auth0" for a database, "samlp" for SAML, "google-oauth2" for Google, and so on.

name.description: Connection name, unique within the tenant.

display_name.description: Name shown on the login page.

strategy.description: Identity provider strategy, e.g. auth0, samlp or google-oauth2.

options.description: Strategy-specific settings, such as credentials or password policy.

enabled_clients.description: Client ids allowed to use this connection.

realms.description: Realms this connection serves, for home realm discovery.

is_domain_connection.description: True to treat this as a domain connection for HRD.

show_as_button.description: True to render the connection as its own login button.

metadata.description: Up to ten string key-value pairs stored with the connection.

output.description: The created connection, with its id.

update_connection.title: Update a connection
update_connection.description: Patch a connection's options, display name or enabled clients. strategy and name cannot change after creation.

display_name.description: New name shown on the login page.

enabled_clients.description: Replacement list of client ids allowed to use the connection.

realms.description: Replacement list of realms for home realm discovery.

is_domain_connection.description: True to treat this as a domain connection for HRD.

show_as_button.description: True to render the connection as its own login button.

delete_connection.title: Delete a connection
delete_connection.description: Delete a connection. For a database connection every user stored in it goes too, so export them first if you need them.

get_connection_status.title: Check a connection's status
get_connection_status.description: Ask Auth0 whether a connection is reachable and correctly configured. Useful as a health check on enterprise connections.

output.description: True when the connection is online and configured.

list_connection_clients.title: List clients enabled on a connection
list_connection_clients.description: List the applications a connection is enabled for, paged by cursor. This is the other side of list_client_connections.

id.description: Connection id whose enabled clients to list.

from.description: Cursor from a previous page, exclusive.

output.description: A page of enabled client ids with the next cursor.

update_connection_clients.title: Enable or disable clients on a connection
update_connection_clients.description: Turn a connection on or off for specific applications. Send a list of client_id and status pairs -- at most 50 per call -- and only those applications change.

clients.description: Entries of client_id and status, where status true enables the connection.

output.description: The connection's enabled clients after the change.

delete_connection_user.title: Delete a user from a database connection
delete_connection_user.description: Delete a user from one database connection by email address, leaving any other identities that user has intact.

id.description: Database connection id to delete from.

email.description: Email address of the user to delete.

list_connection_keys.title: List a connection's signing keys
list_connection_keys.description: List the signing keys Auth0 holds for an enterprise connection, with their algorithms, thumbprints and current state.

id.description: Connection id whose keys to list.

output.description: An array of connection signing keys.

rotate_connection_keys.title: Rotate a connection's signing key
rotate_connection_keys.description: Create a new signing key for the connection and make it current. The previous key stays listed so relying parties can catch up.

id.description: Connection id whose key to rotate.

signing_alg.description: Signing algorithm for the new key.

get_connection_scim_configuration.title: Get a connection's SCIM configuration
get_connection_scim_configuration.description: Read the SCIM provisioning configuration on an enterprise connection, including the attribute mapping and the user id attribute.

id.description: Connection id whose SCIM configuration to read.

output.description: The SCIM configuration with its tenant name and mapping.

create_connection_scim_configuration.title: Enable SCIM on a connection
create_connection_scim_configuration.description: Turn on SCIM provisioning for an enterprise connection. Leave the body empty to take Auth0's default mapping for the strategy.

id.description: Connection id to enable SCIM on.

user_id_attribute.description: SCIM attribute used to build the unique user id.

mapping.description: Entries of auth0 and scim attribute names to map.

update_connection_scim_configuration.title: Update a connection's SCIM configuration
update_connection_scim_configuration.description: Replace the SCIM attribute mapping and user id attribute on a connection. Both fields are required, so send the full mapping.

id.description: Connection id whose SCIM configuration to update.

user_id_attribute.description: SCIM attribute used to build the unique user id.

mapping.description: Entries of auth0 and scim attribute names to map.

delete_connection_scim_configuration.title: Disable SCIM on a connection
delete_connection_scim_configuration.description: Remove the SCIM configuration from a connection, which stops any provisioning that was pushing users into it.

id.description: Connection id to disable SCIM on.

get_connection_scim_default_mapping.title: Get a connection's default SCIM mapping
get_connection_scim_default_mapping.description: Read the attribute mapping Auth0 would apply by default for this connection's strategy, as a starting point for a custom mapping.

id.description: Connection id whose default mapping to read.

list_connection_scim_tokens.title: List a connection's SCIM tokens
list_connection_scim_tokens.description: List the SCIM bearer tokens issued for a connection, with their scopes and expiry. The token values themselves are not returned.

id.description: Connection id whose SCIM tokens to list.

output.description: An array of SCIM tokens with ids, scopes and expiry.

create_connection_scim_token.title: Create a SCIM token for a connection
create_connection_scim_token.description: Issue a bearer token an external identity provider can use to push users into this connection over SCIM. The token value is shown once.

id.description: Connection id to issue the token for.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant the SCIM token.

token_lifetime.description: Lifetime in seconds; must be greater than 900.

output.description: The created token, including its one-time token value.

create_custom_domain.description: Register a custom login domain. auth0_managed_certs lets Auth0 handle the certificate; self_managed_certs expects you to terminate TLS yourself.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to use for logins.

type.description: Who manages the TLS certificate for the domain.

verification_method.description: How ownership is proven. Auth0 only supports txt.

domain_metadata.description: Up to ten string key-value pairs stored with the domain.

update_custom_domain.title: Update a custom domain
update_custom_domain.description: Change the TLS policy, custom client IP header or metadata on a custom domain. The domain name itself is fixed.

custom_client_ip_header.description: Header your proxy puts the client IP in, e.g. cf-connecting-ip.

verify_custom_domain.title: Verify a custom domain
verify_custom_domain.description: Ask Auth0 to check the DNS record for a pending custom domain and finish provisioning it once the record resolves.

output.description: The domain with its verification result and status.

test_custom_domain.title: Test a custom domain

output.description: The test result for the domain.

delete_custom_domain.title: Delete a custom domain
delete_custom_domain.description: Remove a custom domain. Logins pointed at that hostname stop working immediately, so move traffic first.

get_default_custom_domain.title: Get the default custom domain
get_default_custom_domain.description: Read which custom domain Auth0 treats as the tenant default for emails and links.

get_email_provider.title: Get the email provider
get_email_provider.description: Read the tenant's outbound email provider settings, with credentials redacted, including whether it is enabled.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include or exclude.

include_fields.description: True to include the named fields, false to exclude them.

configure_email_provider.title: Configure the email provider
configure_email_provider.description: Set up an outbound email provider for the tenant. credentials carries the API key or SMTP settings the chosen provider needs.

enabled.description: True to start sending through the provider.

default_from_address.description: From address used when a template does not set one.

credentials.description: Provider credentials, such as api_key or SMTP host and password.

settings.description: Provider-specific extras, such as a message region.

update_email_provider.title: Update the email provider
update_email_provider.description: Patch the tenant's email provider -- rotate its credentials, change the default from address, or disable sending.

enabled.description: True to send through the provider, false to stop.

default_from_address.description: From address used when a template does not set one.

delete_email_provider.title: Delete the email provider
delete_email_provider.description: Remove the tenant's email provider, which puts outbound mail back on Auth0's low-volume development sender.

get_email_template.title: Get an email template
get_email_template.description: Read one of the tenant's email templates -- its subject, body, from address and whether it is enabled.

template_name.description: Template to read, e.g. verify_email or reset_email.

update_email_template.title: Update an email template
update_email_template.description: Patch an email template's subject, body or enabled flag. The body is Liquid, so it can interpolate user and application fields.

template_name.description: Template to update, e.g. verify_email or reset_email.

body.description: Template body, in the syntax the template declares.

from.description: From address for this template.

syntax.description: Templating language of the body, normally liquid.

result_url.description: URL the recipient lands on after following the link.

url_lifetime_in_seconds.description: How long the link in the email stays valid.

include_email_in_redirect.description: True to append the email address to the result URL.

enabled.description: True to send this template, false to suppress it.

get_brute_force_protection.title: Get brute-force protection settings
get_brute_force_protection.description: Read the brute-force protection configuration -- whether it is on, the attempt threshold, the shields and the IP allowlist.

update_brute_force_protection.title: Update brute-force protection settings
update_brute_force_protection.description: Change brute-force protection. mode picks whether the counter is per account or per account and IP, and shields decides between blocking and just notifying.

shields.description: Responses to take, such as block and user_notification.

allowlist.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges never blocked.

mode.description: Whether attempts are counted per account or per account and IP.

max_attempts.description: Failed attempts allowed before the shield fires.

get_suspicious_ip_throttling.title: Get suspicious IP throttling settings
get_suspicious_ip_throttling.description: Read the suspicious IP throttling configuration, with the rate limits it applies to logins and signups.

update_suspicious_ip_throttling.title: Update suspicious IP throttling settings
update_suspicious_ip_throttling.description: Change suspicious IP throttling -- the shields it applies and the per-stage rate limits for login and signup attempts.

enabled.description: True to enforce suspicious IP throttling.

shields.description: Responses to take, such as block and admin_notification.

allowlist.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges never throttled.

stage.description: Per-stage rate limits for pre-login and pre-user-registration.

output.description: The updated suspicious IP throttling settings.

get_breached_password_detection.title: Get breached password detection settings
get_breached_password_detection.description: Read the breached password detection configuration, including which shields fire and how the admin is notified.

update_breached_password_detection.title: Update breached password detection settings
update_breached_password_detection.description: Change breached password detection -- whether it is on, what it does when a credential is known to be breached, and the detection method.

enabled.description: True to enforce breached password detection.

shields.description: Responses to take, such as block or admin_notification.

admin_notification_frequency.description: How often admins are emailed, e.g. ["daily"].

stage.description: Per-stage settings for pre-user-registration and pre-change-password.

output.description: The updated breached password detection settings.

get_bot_detection.title: Get bot detection settings
get_bot_detection.description: Read the tenant's bot detection configuration, including the CAPTCHA provider in use on each flow.

get_branding.title: Get branding settings
get_branding.description: Read the tenant's branding -- logo, favicon, colors and font used on the Universal Login pages.

update_branding.title: Update branding settings
update_branding.description: Change the logo, favicon, colors or font used across Universal Login. Logo and favicon URLs must be HTTPS.

logo_url.description: HTTPS URL of the logo shown on login pages.

colors.description: Primary color and page background, as hex values.

font.description: Custom font, as an object with url.

get_universal_login_template.title: Get the Universal Login page template
get_universal_login_template.description: Read the custom Liquid template wrapped around the New Universal Login pages, if the tenant has one.

set_universal_login_template.title: Set the Universal Login page template
set_universal_login_template.description: Replace the Liquid page template that wraps New Universal Login. It must include the auth0 widget placeholder or Auth0 rejects it.

template.description: Liquid page template containing the Universal Login widget tag.

delete_universal_login_template.title: Delete the Universal Login page template
delete_universal_login_template.description: Remove the custom page template so Universal Login falls back to Auth0's default layout.

get_default_branding_theme.title: Get the default branding theme
get_default_branding_theme.description: Read the tenant's default Universal Login theme -- its colors, borders, fonts, page background and widget settings.

get_branding_theme.title: Get a branding theme
get_branding_theme.description: Read one branding theme by id, with the full set of Universal Login style tokens it carries.

create_branding_theme.title: Create a branding theme
create_branding_theme.description: Create a Universal Login theme. Every section -- colors, borders, fonts, page_background and widget -- is required, so read the default theme first and edit it.

colors.description: Color tokens for buttons, links, text and errors.

borders.description: Border radius, widths and button styling.

fonts.description: Font family, sizes and weights for each text role.

page_background.description: Page background color, image URL and positioning.

widget.description: Login widget layout, logo position and header text alignment.

output.description: The created theme, with its id.

update_branding_theme.title: Update a branding theme
update_branding_theme.description: Replace a branding theme's style sections. As with creation, Auth0 wants the complete set of sections rather than a partial patch.

colors.description: Color tokens for buttons, links, text and errors.

borders.description: Border radius, widths and button styling.

fonts.description: Font family, sizes and weights for each text role.

page_background.description: Page background color, image URL and positioning.

widget.description: Login widget layout, logo position and header text alignment.

delete_branding_theme.title: Delete a branding theme
delete_branding_theme.description: Delete a branding theme, which returns Universal Login to the tenant's default styling.

get_prompt_settings.title: Get prompt settings
get_prompt_settings.description: Read the login prompt settings -- which Universal Login experience is active and whether identifier-first is on.

update_prompt_settings.title: Update prompt settings
update_prompt_settings.description: Switch between the new and classic Universal Login experience, or turn identifier-first and WebAuthn-first login on or off.

universal_login_experience.description: Which Universal Login experience to serve.

identifier_first.description: True to ask for the identifier before the password.

webauthn_platform_first_factor.description: True to offer device biometrics as the first factor.

get_prompt_custom_text.title: Get a prompt's custom text
get_prompt_custom_text.description: Read the custom text overrides for one prompt in one language, keyed by screen and then by text key.

prompt.description: Prompt name, e.g. login, signup or mfa.

language.description: Language tag, e.g. en or fr-CA.

set_prompt_custom_text.title: Set a prompt's custom text
set_prompt_custom_text.description: Replace the custom text for one prompt in one language. The body is an object of screen names, each holding the text keys to override.

prompt.description: Prompt name, e.g. login, signup or mfa.

language.description: Language tag, e.g. en or fr-CA.

custom_text.description: Screens mapped to the text keys and strings to override.

get_prompt_partials.title: Get a prompt's partials
get_prompt_partials.description: Read the custom HTML partials inserted into one prompt's screens, for tenants that extend Universal Login with their own markup.

prompt.description: Prompt name whose partials to read.

output.description: The partials keyed by insertion point.

get_prompt_screen_rendering.title: Get a prompt screen's rendering settings
get_prompt_screen_rendering.description: Read the Advanced Customizations rendering configuration for one prompt screen, including whether it uses the standard or advanced mode.

get_guardian_factors.title: List multifactor factors
get_guardian_factors.description: List the Guardian multifactor factors and whether each one is enabled for the tenant.

output.description: The factors with their names and enabled flags.

set_guardian_factor.title: Enable or disable a multifactor factor
set_guardian_factor.description: Turn one Guardian factor on or off for the tenant, such as push notification, OTP, SMS or WebAuthn.

name.description: Factor name, e.g. push-notification, otp, sms or webauthn-roaming.

enabled.description: True to enable the factor, false to disable it.

delete_guardian_enrollment.title: Delete a multifactor enrollment
delete_guardian_enrollment.description: Delete one Guardian enrollment by id, which is how you clear a specific factor a user can no longer use.

list_grants.title: List user consent grants
list_grants.description: List the consent grants users have given applications, with the audience and scopes each grant covers.

audience.description: Restrict to grants for this API identifier.

delete_grant.title: Delete a consent grant
delete_grant.description: Delete one consent grant by id, so the user is asked to consent again the next time that application requests those scopes.

delete_user_grants.description: Delete every consent grant belonging to one user, revoking the permissions they have given applications.

get_session.title: Get a session
get_session.description: Read one session by id, with its device, clients, authentication details and expiry timestamps.

update_session.description: Attach or replace the metadata stored on a session, as string key-value pairs your own logic can read back later.

session_metadata.description: String key-value pairs to store on the session.

revoke_session.title: Revoke a session
revoke_session.description: Revoke one session so the user is signed out of it, without touching their other sessions.

delete_session.title: Delete a session
delete_session.description: Delete a session record outright. Like revoking it, this signs the user out of that session.

list_refresh_tokens.title: List a user's refresh tokens by query
list_refresh_tokens.description: List refresh tokens for one user, optionally narrowed to a single client. user_id is required -- there is no tenant-wide listing.

get_refresh_token.description: Read one refresh token record by id, with the client, session and rotation history behind it.

delete_refresh_token.title: Delete a refresh token
delete_refresh_token.description: Revoke one refresh token by id, so the application holding it has to get a fresh grant from the user.

revoke_refresh_tokens.description: Revoke refresh tokens by id -- up to 100 at a time -- or everything belonging to a user, optionally narrowed to one client and audience.

user_id.description: Revoke every refresh token belonging to this user.

client_id.description: Narrow a user-wide revocation to this application.

audience.description: Narrow a user-wide revocation to this API identifier.

list_device_credentials.title: List device credentials
list_device_credentials.description: List the public-key device credentials registered for refresh token exchange, filtered by user or client.

user_id.description: Restrict to credentials belonging to this user.

client_id.description: Restrict to credentials for this application.

delete_device_credential.title: Delete a device credential
delete_device_credential.description: Delete one device credential, which stops that device from exchanging its key for tokens.

list_network_acls.title: List network ACLs
list_network_acls.description: List the tenant's network access control lists, in the priority order Auth0 evaluates them.

output.description: A page of network ACLs with their rules and priorities.

get_network_acl.title: Get a network ACL
get_network_acl.description: Read one network access control list by id, with the match conditions and action in its rule.

create_network_acl.description: Create a network access control list. rule holds the match conditions and the action -- block, allow, log or redirect -- and priority decides the order rules are evaluated in.

update_network_acl.title: Update a network ACL
update_network_acl.description: Patch a network ACL's description, active flag, priority or rule. Send only the fields you want changed.

active.description: True to enforce the ACL, false to leave it inactive.

priority.description: New evaluation order; lower numbers first.

delete_network_acl.title: Delete a network ACL
delete_network_acl.description: Delete a network access control list, so traffic it was matching is handled by the remaining rules.

list_self_service_profiles.title: List self-service SSO profiles
list_self_service_profiles.description: List the self-service profiles that let customer administrators set up their own enterprise connection, with the strategies each allows.

include_totals.description: True to wrap the results with total counts.

get_self_service_profile.title: Get a self-service SSO profile
get_self_service_profile.description: Read one self-service profile by id, with its branding, allowed strategies and user attribute mapping.

create_self_service_profile.title: Create a self-service SSO profile
create_self_service_profile.description: Create a self-service profile. allowed_strategies limits which identity providers the customer admin may pick, and user_attributes lists the attributes they are asked to map.

branding.description: Logo and colors shown in the self-service flow.

allowed_strategies.description: Connection strategies the customer admin may choose from.

user_attributes.description: Attributes to map, each with name, description and is_optional.

update_self_service_profile.title: Update a self-service SSO profile
update_self_service_profile.description: Patch a self-service profile's name, branding, allowed strategies or attribute mapping.

branding.description: New logo and colors for the self-service flow.

allowed_strategies.description: Replacement list of allowed connection strategies.

delete_self_service_profile.title: Delete a self-service SSO profile
delete_self_service_profile.description: Delete a self-service profile. Tickets already issued from it stop working; connections it created stay.

create_sso_ticket.description: Mint a one-time URL a customer administrator can follow to configure their own enterprise connection. Pass connection_id to have them edit an existing connection instead of creating one.

revoke_sso_ticket.title: Revoke a self-service SSO ticket
revoke_sso_ticket.description: Revoke an outstanding self-service ticket so its setup link can no longer be used.

list_forms.title: List forms

update_form.description: Patch a form's nodes, messages, translations or styling. Structural fields replace what is stored rather than merging.

delete_form.description: Delete a form. Any flow that renders it stops working, so check the flows that reference it first.

list_flows.title: List flows
list_flows.description: List the tenant's flows, the sequences of actions Auth0 Flows runs outside the login pipeline.

hydrate.description: Extra fields to expand on each flow.

get_flow.title: Get a flow
get_flow.description: Read one flow by id, with the ordered actions it runs and the vault connections they use.

create_flow.description: Create a flow from an ordered list of actions, each naming the step it runs and the parameters it takes.

update_flow.title: Update a flow
update_flow.description: Patch a flow's name or replace the ordered list of actions it runs.

list_flow_executions.description: List the recorded executions of one flow, so you can see what ran and which step failed.

get_flow_vault_connection.description: Read one Flows vault connection by id, with its type, environment and whether its credentials are still valid.

get_tenant_settings.description: Read the tenant's settings -- friendly name, support contacts, session lifetimes, default audience and directory, enabled locales and feature flags.

update_tenant_settings.description: Patch tenant-wide settings such as session and idle session lifetimes, default audience and directory, support links, allowed logout URLs and enabled locales.
